name: MNC Solution Co.,Ltd
summary: MNC Solution Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells hydraulic parts for the construction machinery and defense market in Korea. It offers gun/turret driving systems, missile steering products, naval systems, launcher systems, suspensions, hydraulic main pumps, fuel supply controls, servo valves, fast steering mirrors, launch vehicle, and high-precision tracking systems. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Changwon-si, South Korea. MNC Solution Co.,Ltd is a subsidiary of Socioswell2See Investment No. 2 Corporate Financial Stability Co., Ltd.
